title: Scarf Workshop for Betty
shortDescription: A guided 10-day workshop to knit your first scarf
description: This guided workshop takes you through the complete process of knitting a beautiful scarf, from choosing yarn to blocking the finished piece.

days.title: Define the scarf
days.shortDescription: Choose stitch, width, and finish line.

blocks.content:
Welcome to Day 1! Today we're making the decisions that set up your entire scarf.

## What you'll decide today

- **Stitch pattern** – What texture do you want?
- **Width** – How wide should your scarf be?
- **Finish line** – What's your target length?

blocks.title: Pro tip
blocks.content: Don't overthink it. A simple garter stitch scarf can be stunning.

items.text: Post your decisions on the hub

blocks.content:
Today is all about swatching. This saves time later.

## Why swatch?

Swatching tells you:
- How many stitches you need for your target width
- Whether you like how the fabric feels
- If your yarn and needles are a good match

blocks.title: Important
blocks.content: Cast on at least 20 stitches and knit at least 20 rows.

items.text: Post a photo of your swatch
